requirements.quote: The IPR or copyright/License of the SEM / AMI solution to be owned by the TP.
requirements.text: The bidder must own the IPR or copyright/license of the SEM/AMI solution.

requirements.quote: Relevant documents to the ownership to be submitted
requirements.text: Submit relevant documents proving ownership of the SEM/AMI solution.

requirements.quote: TP should have designed, engineered, integrated, manufactured/ assembled the offered product and obtained the required Type Approval Certificate from any NABL/International accredited agencies.
requirements.text: Bidder must have designed, engineered, and certified the product with NABL/International accredited agencies.

requirements.quote: TP must confirm that there are no Patent / legal issues that might become hindrance as per scope of RFP at any stage.
requirements.text: Bidder must confirm no patent or legal issues hindering the RFP scope.

requirements.quote: An undertaking of owning IPR (Intellectual Property Right) or Copyright/License for the SEM design needs to be submitted.
requirements.text: Submit an undertaking of owning IPR or copyright/license for SEM design.

requirements.quote: If Principal Designer is different, authorization letter in original in the name of TP must be provided for Transfer of Technology to ITI.
requirements.text: Provide authorization letter for technology transfer if the principal designer is different.

requirements.quote: The TP shall provide the design of the offered product vide Transfer of Technology enabling ITI to manufacture with following steps.
requirements.text: Provide product design for technology transfer to ITI for manufacturing.

requirements.quote: SMT assembling using components supplied by suppliers
requirements.text: Include SMT assembling using supplier-provided components in the manufacturing process.

requirements.quote: Bill of materials list along with technical specifications, part nos. and the OEM details
requirements.text: Provide a bill of materials with specifications, part numbers, and OEM details.

requirements.quote: THT and manual assembling using component supplied by suppliers
requirements.text: Include THT and manual assembling using supplier-provided components in the manufacturing process.

requirements.quote: Mechanical part assembling using component supplied by suppliers
requirements.text: Include mechanical part assembling using supplier-provided components in the manufacturing process.
Include PCBA testing in the manufacturing process.

requirements.quote: Plastic injection using materials supplied by suppliers
requirements.text: Include plastic injection using supplier-provided materials in the manufacturing process.
Include meter assembly in the manufacturing process.
Include meter calibration in the manufacturing process.
